crossRefs.note: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them…
Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people?…
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will…
(as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
“All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.
“I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.
Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”
But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and…
But since we stopped burning incense to the queen of the sky, and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked…

translations.web: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.’
translations.bsb: Therefore I declared it to you long ago; I announced it before it came to pass, so that you could not claim, ‘My idol has done this; my carved image and molten god has ordained it.’
translations.kjv: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded
translations.asv: therefore I have declared it to thee from of old; before it came to pass I showed it thee; lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
